unlanded --repo <path> --range <a>..<b> (or --since <ref>) --ips <dir|file|id,id> [--ledger <id|f>]  names each plan of record no landing on the trunk names, net of reverts, and exits 1 on one; a plan whose Status opens with Withdrawn, Superseded or Deferred owes none; with --ledger, a plan whose accepted record lands it by an amendment record the ledger holds is landed; a landing is read as a commit naming the plan, never as what the commit changed (R-LANDING, D12)

versions <assetId> [--log] [--status]  the versions CanonQ holds of a document, newest first, each with its date and the current one marked, numbered as the replaced texts plus one; --status adds each version's status line; --log reads the Change Log against them and exits 1 on a row naming a version CanonQ does not hold, an older document with no Change Log passing with a note. A call with no asset id is refused, and names `version`

wave script --plan <id|f> [--manifest <id|f> --ledger <id|f> [--docs <dir>]] [--out <file>] [--check <script>]  a fleet script written from the ruled wave plan, in the form the Workflow tool runs: the meta statement first, three declaration lines naming the plan, its ruling record, its binding, the digest of the prompt set and every setting in force, the openWave call, one runStage call per member in the ruled order carrying its prompts, its fix rounds and each role's model, and the call of main last. Prints each setting with its source. --out writes the block under the declaration lines; --check reads a script and says whether its plan, its settings and its prompts are the ones the plan rules. It refuses an unruled plan, a plan with no prompts and a plan that rules the review off where it must stay on at exit 2, writes nothing for a hand plan, and prints no wave token; under --manifest and --ledger a reading of a lens bar in force for the stage of a member writes the ruled bar, and each reading in force for that stage adds a line naming it and its ruling record at the end of each lens brief of the member; the documents a row of a reading rests on are read from {dir}/{id}.md under --docs, or from the assets the tracked table names, and a reading in force for a stage whose document neither reaches is refused by name, here, in wave lock and in both --resume forms

wave draft --manifest <id|f> --ledger <id|f> --members <id|f,...> [--mode fleet|hand] [--seq NNN] [--supersedes <plan>] --out <answers.json>  the answers of a new wave plan: every setting's value in force marked as offered, the mode, the integration run line, each member's rounds and the test-practice sentence

wave prompts --draft <answers.json> --manifest <id|f> --ledger <id|f> --members <id|f,...> --repo <path> --base <sha> --branch <b> --work <dir> --clones <dir> --release <x.y.z> --attribution "<line>" [--connector <name>] [--lenses <a,b>] --out <answers.json>  where wave.prompts reads template, renders every prompt of the wave from the prompt template into the draft's answers with the line Rendered:; --check --plan <id|f> --manifest <id|f> --ledger <id|f> --members <id|f,...> --repo <path> renders them again and names each that moved; --start <IP id> --role <build|review|fix|rereview> [--lens <name>] --plan <id|f> [--facts <f>] --out <f> writes the brief of one agent start and the one line that names it

wave lock --plan <id|f> --manifest <id|f> --ledger <id|f> --arch <id|f|none> [--map <f.json>] [--record n] [--name <WAVE-PLAN-X-N>] [--branch b] [--docs <dir>] [--repo p]  write and commit .mc17/wave.json on the branch the plan's wave.branch setting names, with the plan's mode, binding, settings and prompt digests and its ruling record's kind and date; refuses an unruled or superseded plan, a record that is no ruling, another branch, a review-off plan where the review must stay on, and an edge of the ARCH that waits on a plan outside the wave that has not landed; prints the token ONCE

wave lock --resume <IP id> --plan <id|f> --manifest <id|f> --ledger <id|f> --runner-return <f> [--base <sha>] [--accept <record> | --fix <record>] [--docs <dir>] [--repo p]  take the remainder of a stopped wave into the standing lock, under the token in MC17_WAVE_TOKEN: the members from <IP id> on, the base the runner's return names or --base, the acceptance or the targeted fix of a stopped stage checked against the ledger and the return, and the remainder script's digests; refuses a member the base's history does not hold, counting a member landed through a merge commit that names its plan alone

wave script --resume --plan <id|f> --manifest <id|f> --ledger <id|f> [--docs <dir>] [--repo p] [--out <f> | --check <script>]  the remainder script the lock's resume entry names, from the same ruled plan: seeded at the entry's base, carrying the acceptance or the targeted fix on its first stage and resume=<IP id> on its settings line; --check reads a script against it and runs the launch reading against the lock
wave verify [--token t] [--repo p]   the token against the lock (MC17_WAVE_TOKEN by default)
